```python
import sys, json
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

def f(x):
    return float(np.round(x, 2))

def pct(x):
    return float(np.round(x, 1))

df = pd.read_csv(sys.argv[1])

facts = []

# Totals
tot_rev_tw = df['Revenue_TW'].sum(skipna=True)
tot_rev_lw = df['Revenue_LW'].sum(skipna=True)
tot_rev_ly = df['Revenue_LY'].sum(skipna=True)
tot_units_tw = df['Units_TW'].sum(skipna=True)
tot_units_lw = df['Units_LW'].sum(skipna=True)
tot_orders_tw = df['Orders_TW'].sum(skipna=True)
tot_orders_lw = df['Orders_LW'].sum(skipna=True)

facts.append({"entity":"TOTAL","metric":"revenue","period":"TW","value":f(tot_rev_tw),"formula":"sum(Revenue_TW)"})
facts.append({"entity":"TOTAL","metric":"revenue","period":"LW","value":f(tot_rev_lw),"formula":"sum(Revenue_LW)"})
if not pd.isna(tot_rev_ly) and tot_rev_ly != 0:
    facts.append({"entity":"TOTAL","metric":"revenue","period":"LY","value":f(tot_rev_ly),"formula":"sum(Revenue_LY)"})

facts.append({"entity":"TOTAL","metric":"units","period":"TW","value":f(tot_units_tw),"formula":"sum(Units_TW)"})
facts.append({"entity":"TOTAL","metric":"units","period":"LW","value":f(tot_units_lw),"formula":"sum(Units_LW)"})

facts.append({"entity":"TOTAL","metric":"orders","period":"TW","value":f(tot_orders_tw),"formula":"sum(Orders_TW)"})
facts.append({"entity":"TOTAL","metric":"orders","period":"LW","value":f(tot_orders_lw),"formula":"sum(Orders_LW)"})

if tot_rev_lw != 0 and not pd.isna(tot_rev_lw):
    wow = (tot_rev_tw - tot_rev_lw) / tot_rev_lw * 100
    facts.append({"entity":"TOTAL","metric":"revenue","period":"WoW","value":pct(wow),
                  "formula":"(sum(Revenue_TW)-sum(Revenue_LW))/sum(Revenue_LW)*100"})

if not pd.isna(tot_rev_ly) and tot_rev_ly != 0:
    yoy = (tot_rev_tw - tot_rev_ly) / tot_rev_ly * 100
    facts.append({"entity":"TOTAL","metric":"revenue","period":"YoY","value":pct(yoy),
                  "formula":"(sum(Revenue_TW)-sum(Revenue_LY))/sum(Revenue_LY)*100"})

# Top entities by revenue TW
top_rev = df.dropna(subset=['Revenue_TW']).sort_values('Revenue_TW', ascending=False).head(5)
for _, row in top_rev.iterrows():
    facts.append({"entity":row['Entity'],"metric":"revenue","period":"TW","value":f(row['Revenue_TW']),
                  "formula":"Revenue_TW"})
    if not pd.isna(row.get('Share_Pct', np.nan)):
        facts.append({"entity":row['Entity'],"metric":"share","period":"TW","value":pct(row['Share_Pct']),
                      "formula":"Share_Pct"})
    if not pd.isna(row.get('Rank', np.nan)):
        facts.append({"entity":row['Entity'],"metric":"rank","period":"TW","value":f(row['Rank']),
                      "formula":"Rank"})

# Biggest WoW gainer and loser
wow_df = df.dropna(subset=['WoW_Pct'])
if not wow_df.empty:
    gainer = wow_df.loc[wow_df['WoW_Pct'].idxmax()]
    loser = wow_df.loc[wow_df['WoW_Pct'].idxmin()]
    facts.append({"entity":gainer['Entity'],"metric":"revenue","period":"WoW","value":pct(gainer['WoW_Pct']),
                  "formula":"WoW_Pct (top gainer)"})
    facts.append({"entity":loser['Entity'],"metric":"revenue","period":"WoW","value":pct(loser['WoW_Pct']),
                  "formula":"WoW_Pct (top decliner)"})

# Biggest YoY gainer and loser
yoy_df = df.dropna(subset=['YoY_Pct'])
if not yoy_df.empty:
    gainer = yoy_df.loc[yoy_df['YoY_Pct'].idxmax()]
    loser = yoy_df.loc[yoy_df['YoY_Pct'].idxmin()]
    facts.append({"entity":gainer['Entity'],"metric":"revenue","period":"YoY","value":pct(gainer['YoY_Pct']),
                  "formula":"YoY_Pct (top gainer)"})
    facts.append({"entity":loser['Entity'],"metric":"revenue","period":"YoY","value":pct(loser['YoY_Pct']),
                  "formula":"YoY_Pct (top decliner)"})

# Top entity by units TW
units_df = df.dropna(subset=['Units_TW'])
if not units_df.empty:
    top_units = units_df.loc[units_df['Units_TW'].idxmax()]
    facts.append({"entity":top_units['Entity'],"metric":"units","period":"TW","value":f(top_units['Units_TW']),
                  "formula":"max(Units_TW)"})

# Top entity by orders TW
orders_df = df.dropna(subset=['Orders_TW'])
if not orders_df.empty:
    top_orders = orders_df.loc[orders_df['Orders_TW'].idxmax()]
    facts.append({"entity":top_orders['Entity'],"metric":"orders","period":"TW","value":f(top_orders['Orders_TW']),
                  "formula":"max(Orders_TW)"})

# Rank 1 entity details
rank1 = df[df['Rank'] == 1]
if not rank1.empty:
    r = rank1.iloc[0]
    if not pd.isna(r['Revenue_LW']):
        facts.append({"entity":r['Entity'],"metric":"revenue","period":"LW","value":f(r['Revenue_LW']),
                      "formula":"Revenue_LW (rank 1 entity)"})

facts = facts[:25]

print(json.dumps(facts))
```
